name: xbert
description: XBert plugins for accounting firms and bookkeepers — daily reconciliation today, more workflows shipping soon.

plugins.name: xbert-aged-receivables
plugins.description: Prioritised debtor call-list with promise-tracking and escalation ladders — turn an aged receivables report into the week's chase plan.

plugins.name: xbert-balance-sheet-explain
plugins.description: Movement-by-movement balance sheet review with reconciliation status, manual journal trace, and FAR-to-GL accumulated depreciation check.

plugins.name: xbert-bank-statement-upload
plugins.description: Turn any bank statement format into the file your accounting system can ingest — PDF, CSV, OFX, QIF, or Excel.

plugins.name: xbert-bas-prep
plugins.description: Pre-lodgement BAS readiness check for Australian clients — bank rec, GST, PAYG-W, payroll, super, outstanding XBerts and prior-period comparison, with an audit document for the file.

plugins.name: xbert-bill-intake
plugins.description: Inbox-to-ledger bill processing with duplicate guard, AI coding suggestions, and supplier dedup. v1 ships dedup + coding + approval task; approver routing is v2.

plugins.name: xbert-capacity
plugins.description: Billable utilisation and WIP variance reporting at practice and client level, using XBert data.

plugins.name: xbert-client-fee-review
plugins.description: Evidence-based annual fee review across the whole client book, with per-client drill-down.

plugins.name: xbert-client-onboard
plugins.description: Structured new-client onboarding with checklist, practice-owner gate, and rules baseline. v1 orchestrates the workflow; COA + opening-balance steps are checklist items the bookkeeper completes in the ledger.

plugins.name: xbert-config-audit
plugins.description: Is XBert configured consistently across your book? Spot inconsistencies, gaps, and drift in one pass.

plugins.name: xbert-cross-sell-opportunities
plugins.description: Find your highest-value cross-sell opportunities by matching client profile to service uptake patterns.

plugins.name: xbert-div7a-schedule
plugins.description: Division 7A loan schedule with minimum repayment calc and benchmark-rate-ready output. v1 narrow: manual benchmark-rate entry until a Tax_GetATOBenchmarkRate tool ships.

plugins.name: xbert-end-of-period-dashboard
plugins.description: Period-close readiness dashboard fusing workflow, data quality and lodgement obligations across every client.

plugins.name: xbert-fbt-prep
plugins.description: Annual FBT exposure review for Australian clients — scan motor vehicles, entertainment, employee benefits and salary packaging arrangements before the 21 May return deadline.

plugins.name: xbert-fs-pack
plugins.description: Year-end financial statement pack ready for partner review — SPFS structure with comparative period, notes shell, and GPFS variant for audit clients.

plugins.name: xbert-gst-prep-nz
plugins.description: Pre-lodgement GST readiness check for New Zealand clients — boxes 5-15 validated against bank rec, payroll and outstanding XBerts, audit document for IRD filing.

plugins.name: xbert-ias-prep
plugins.description: Pre-lodgement IAS readiness check for Australian clients — verify PAYG withholding and instalment data before lodging the Instalment Activity Statement.

plugins.name: xbert-instalment-variation
plugins.description: PAYG-I and GST instalment variation recommendation with cashflow run-rate, YTD profit trend, and GIC-risk audit trail.

plugins.name: xbert-intercompany-recon
plugins.description: Reconcile inter-entity loans, recharges, and trade balances across every group entity in one pass — a unique XBert capability via cross-tenant access.

plugins.name: xbert-month-end-pack
plugins.description: Month-end financial pack the partner can hand to the client — P&L vs budget, BS movement walk, cashflow vs forecast, and KPI roll-up in a single Word document.

plugins.name: xbert-mtd-prep
plugins.description: Making Tax Digital for Income Tax readiness assessment for UK clients — chart of accounts mapped to HMRC categories, income threshold, simplified vs full reporting eligibility, quarterly reporting readiness.

plugins.name: xbert-payment-run
plugins.description: Weekly pay-run brief with remittance drafts ready for review. v1 produces the schedule + remittances; ABA payment file generation is v2.

plugins.name: xbert-payroll-close
plugins.description: Pre-run sanity checks and post-run reconciliation for every pay cycle, including STP Phase 2 hygiene and bank-out reconciliation.

plugins.name: xbert-practice-health-check
plugins.description: Portfolio-wide data-quality and financial-health snapshot with diagnostic recommendations per client.

plugins.name: xbert-practice-metrics
plugins.description: Monthly partner-meeting one-pager — revenue, lockup, write-offs, service-line P&L, client risk segmentation.

plugins.name: xbert-pulse
plugins.description: Detect material changes in client transactional tempo and propose actions using XBert.

plugins.name: xbert-reconcile
plugins.description: Reconcile bank lines against ledger entries using XBert matching.

plugins.name: xbert-stp-finalisation
plugins.description: Annual STP Phase 2 finalisation check for Australian clients — verify YTD wages, PAYG-W and super are accurate per employee before the 14 July ATO deadline.

plugins.name: xbert-super-check
plugins.description: Quarterly Superannuation Guarantee check for Australian clients — verify SG calculated, posted, and paid through the clearing house by the 28th, with SGC-risk audit trail.

plugins.name: xbert-tax-reconciliation
plugins.description: Accounting-to-tax reconciliation worksheet — every Schedule M-style adjustment from accounting profit to taxable income, per-entity worksheet, with working papers.

plugins.name: xbert-tpar
plugins.description: Annual Taxable Payments Annual Report (TPAR) preparation for Australian clients in building, cleaning, courier, IT, road-freight and security industries — due 28 August.

plugins.name: xbert-trial-balance-alignment
plugins.description: Reconcile your trial balance against the accountant's financials with a journal-ready Excel workbook and Word audit document.

plugins.name: xbert-vat-prep
plugins.description: Pre-submission VAT readiness check for UK clients — boxes 1-9 validated, MTD compliance verified, partial exemption and reverse charge flagged, audit document for the file.

plugins.name: xbert-workflow-review
plugins.description: Run a structural audit of your XBert workflow setup — template consolidation, budget accuracy, workload balance, and setup hygiene.
